description: List pending, unexpired invitations to join the organization, newest first. Selected mailbox IDs are limited to mailboxes visible to this API credential and may be partial.
name: shipmail_list_member_invitations

mailbox_ids.description: Mailbox IDs visible to this API credential. Empty when scope is "all"; for "selected", the list can be partial when the credential reaches only some granted mailboxes.

newsletter_role.description: "editor" lets the invitee edit newsletters. Only a member can carry it.

title: List Member Invitations
